title: Boss intro card, arena framing, victory sting, per-boss themes
player_outcome: Every boss arrival feels like an event: a brief cinematic camera pull-back/letterbox, a big title card with the boss name and a subtitle (e.g. 'SKELETRON — Curse of the Old Man'), the boss's own music theme, screen shake; on defeat a victory sting, slow-mo moment and the title card fading 'DEFEATED'.
design: Data: optional `intro` block on boss defs (subtitle, card colour, camera framing distance, letterbox seconds) in data/enemies/*.json.

Engine: BossIntro overlay (uses the P2 theme/font), CameraRig framing that never takes control away for more than ~1.5 s and can be skipped, CameraShake punch, MusicDirector per-boss theme mapping (compose distinct themes for King Slime, Eye, Eater/Brain, Skeletron, Queen Bee, Wall of Flesh, mechs, Plantera, Golem, Duke, Empress, Moon Lord with tools/audio composer variations), victory sting + 0.4 s time-scale dip.
Consumes the bosses session's P4-03 announcement events; no duplicate messages in the chat log.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
